scope: Corollary 3.8 (No shadowing at recorded stops) of the manuscript “The joint scaling limit of critical Ashkin-Teller currents” (preprints/The-joint-scaling-limit-of-critical-Ashkin-Teller-currents-October-6-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 233 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 cec129cca8c2a0a6), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 26. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Fix a buffered box Q and b > 0. At a stop τ of an exterior-attached seed exploration, let Fτ be its frozen connected cell region, including the initial walls, all visited seed vertices, and all clusters already revealed. Let Ξδ(τ; b, η) =  some unsearched N cluster has a connected passage γ ⊂ Q, diam γ ≥ b, γ ⊂ Fη τ  . For allowed exact cut or (s, W) stopping histories Hτ with the supported residual product class, P[Ξδ(τ; b, η) | Hτ ] ≤ ωQ,b(η, δ), lim η↓0 lim sup δ↓0 ωQ,b(η, δ) = 0, (3.17) uniformly over positive probability histories. Exterior colors rendered irrelevant by a completed cut are allowed. Arbitrary interior d pins, or conditioning on a later visibility event, are not part of this statement. For an exploration in the enclosing box of Theorem 3.6, index stops by their rank among discoveries of clusters of diameter at least b, and let τ0 be the initial stop. All intervening smaller discoveries are included in each frozen Fτi . If Dδ(b) is the number of these records, then, for every integer K, P[∃ 0 ≤ i ≤ Dδ(b) : Ξδ(τi; b, η) | initial cut data] ≤ Ce−cK + (K + 1)ωQ,b(η, δ). (3.18) The indices here are recorded macroscopic ranks, not raw discovery numbers. If a random width ηδ tends to zero only on a limiting event E, the usable deterministic inclusion is, for fixed η, E ∩ Ξδ(τ; b, ηδ) ⊆ Ξδ(τ; b, η) ∪ E ∩ {ηδ > η}  . (3.19) Thus one first fixes η, takes the mesh limit (and Fatou’s inequality when passing to a limit event), and then sends η to zero. No estimate is asserted after conditioning on E.
